name: Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk
summary: At the Crossroads, Thork seeks proof that Kreenig Snarlsnout has fallen. His tusk marks the end of the Razormane leader's attacks on Horde caravans in the northern Barrens.

sections.title: A Trophy of Severed Ambition
sections.body: Horde caravans traveling west from Durotar face constant attacks in the Barrens. Those raids grew bolder under Kreenig Snarlsnout, a fierce Razormane leader. Thork, commander of the Crossroads watch, ordered Kreenig killed to disrupt the quilboars' coordination. His tusk offers proof that the leader is dead and insults the Razormane, weakening their resolve and leaving their fighters without central direction.

faq.answer: Kreenig Snarlsnout led the Razormane quilboar encamped northeast of the Crossroads. He organized attacks on Horde caravans traveling along the main road from Durotar, making the supply route dangerous until his death.

faq.q: Why does Thork want the tusk specifically?
faq.answer: Thork wants the tusk as proof that Kreenig is dead and as an insult to the Razormane. Taking a fallen chieftain's tusk wounds their pride and demoralizes the surviving raiders.
The tusk comes from Kreenig Snarlsnout's camp northeast of the Crossroads, near the mountain foothills just south of the main road crossing from Durotar into the Barrens.

faq.q: What effect does taking Kreenig down have on the Barrens?
faq.answer: Thork believes the Razormane raiders will falter without Kreenig's leadership. His death throws their ranks into disarray and curbs further attacks on vital supply shipments.

angles.text: Caravans carry weapons, provisions, and settlers from Durotar, sustaining the Horde's expansion into the Barrens. Bringing Thork this tusk helps protect those lifelines.
For an orc of the Crossroads, taking a trophy from a defeated commander is practical warfare: it shows strength and sows panic among the enemy.
